Of this set, the only wars directly involving great powers, by Levy's criteria, were the Russian invasion of Hungary (1956), the Sinai war (1956), the Sino-Indian war (1962), and the war in Vietnam (1965-73). Only one of the four took place in Europe. In Hungary one of the world's dominant powers put down rebellion in a satellite state. In Sinai, France and Britain intervened quickly after Israel invaded Egyptian territory and Egypt, retaliating, entered the Suez Canal zone and sank ships to block the canal. A United Nations peacekeeping force stabilized the territory, and after two months Israel withdrew its forces from the Sinai peninsula, except for the Gaza Strip and Sharm el Sheikh. On the Chinese Indian border, Chinese troops invaded highland territories after India attempted to occupy a high ridge in a disputed zone. The Chinese stopped in their tracks and then began withdrawing.

越南冲突在持续时间和伤亡方面都远远超过其他各场；在其残酷的十年中，它造成了约120万人战斗死亡，再加上不计其数的平民伤亡（Small and Singer 1982: 93）。在那里，前殖民宗主国法国已经撤出，留下一个分裂国家两半之间的战争。经过两年的秘密卷入之后，世界上最强大的国家美国以毁灭性——但最终无效——的力量公开介入。美军后来入侵邻国柬埔寨，并轰炸其城市。一个正在崛起的大国中国隔着边界密切注视；苏联向北越输送补给；澳大利亚、新西兰、韩国、菲律宾和泰国援助美国在南方的努力；而整个冲突则外溢为老挝内战。柬越战争同样源于美国干预越南期间开始的斗争。

The Vietnamese conflict far surpassed the others in duration and casualties; over its ten brutal years, it produced some 1 .2 million battle deaths, plus countless civilian casualties (Small and Singer 1982: 93). There the former colonial overlord, France, had withdrawn, leaving behind a war between two halves of a divided state. After two years of clandestine involvement, the world's greatest power, the United States, then intervened openly with devastating - but finally ineffectual - force. US troops later invaded the neighboring state of Cambodia, and bombed its cities. A rising great power, China, watched closely from just across the border, as the Soviet Union sent in supplies for the north, as Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, the Philippines, and Thailand aided the American effort in the south, and as the whole conflict boiled over into a Laotian civil war. The Cambodian-Vietnamese war likewise grew from struggles that began during the American intervention in Vietnam.

越南战争戏剧性地展示了国家体系所发生的变化。大国之间或大国进行的战争已变得相对稀少，但破坏力巨大。在所有主要战争中，发生在既有国家内部的比例越来越大，因为一个或多个大国为支持内战中的地方派别而直接或间接介入。除了分离主义要求这一重要例外，争夺很少涉及某个国家将要占领的领土；相反，交战各方争夺的是哪些群体将在既定边界内控制现有国家。国家对少数民族的迫害、消灭或驱逐开始制造世界历史上前所未有规模的难民。然而，两极的苏美霸权取代欧洲协调体制，摧毁了全面和平解决方案的做法。

The Vietnam War dramatizes what had happened to the state system. Wars among or by the great powers had become relatively infrequent but immensely destructive. An increasing share of all major wars occurred within constituted states, as one or more of the great powers intervened directly or indirectly on behalf of local parties to a civil war. With the important exception of separatist demands, the contest rarely concerned the territory to be occupied by a given state; instead, the combatants fought over what groups were to control the existing state within its established boundaries. State persecution, liquidation, or expulsion of ethnic minorities began to generate refugees on a scale unprecedented in world history. Yet the displacement of the European concert by bipolar Soviet-American hegemony destroyed the practice of general peace settlements.
这一组变化如果持续下去，就构成与过去的显著断裂。它改变了战争的赌注：一个国家的统治者再也不能希望通过交战获得（或担心因此失去）大片领土。以色列与邻国的领土战争不会让18世纪的任何欧洲人感到惊讶，但在1945年以来的时期，它们已成为反常现象。战争越来越多地涉及：在每个国家里谁进行统治，哪些国家将控制其他国家的政策，以及国家之间将发生什么样的资源、人口和货物转移。

This set of changes, if it persists, constitutes a remarkable break with the past. It alters the stakes of war: no longer can a state's rulers hope to gain (or fear to lose) substantial territory through belligerence. Israel's territorial wars with its neighbors would have surprised no European of the eighteenth century, but in the period since 1945 they have become anomalies. Wars increasingly concern who is to rule in each state, which states will control the policies of other states, and what transfers of resources, people, and goods among states will occur.

zh: 国家相连的世界的形成
en: THE CREATION OF A STATE-LINKED WORLD

children: 那么，在过去五百年中发生了三件引人注目的事。第一，几乎整个欧洲都已形成为具有明确边界和相互关系的民族国家。第二，欧洲体系已扩展到几乎整个世界。第三，其他国家协同行动，对新国家的组织与领土施加了日益增长的影响。这三项变化紧密相连，因为欧洲的主导国家通过殖民、征服和对非欧洲国家的渗透积极传播这一体系。先建立国际联盟、后建立联合国，不过是对把全地球人民组织进单一国家体系这一进程的批准与合理化。

During the last five hundred years, then, three striking things have occurred. First, almost all of Europe has formed into national states with well-defined boundaries and mutual relations. Second, the European system has spread to virtually the entire world. Third, other states, acting in concert, have exerted a growing influence over the organization and territory of new states. The three changes link closely, since Europe's leading states actively spread the system by colonization, conquest, and penetration of non-European states. The creation first of a League of Nations, then of a United Nations, simply ratified and rationalized the organization of all the earth's people into a single state system.

请注意这些变化的含义。大体而言，国家形成已从相对“内部”的过程转变为强烈“外部”的过程。在我们所考察的整个历史中，战争一直对国家形成产生重大影响；就此而言，这一过程始终是外部的。然而，我们越往前追溯，就越看到统治者和想要成为统治者的人努力驯服他们名义上控制的领土内的人口，击退这些领土内的武装对手，征服邻近的土地和人民，并建立自己的武力垄断。于是我们看到他们不经意地建造出这样的国家：其结构带着使之产生的斗争与讨价还价的印记。反过来，我们越往后看，就越目睹国家之间的协调对任何一个特定国家的命运具有日益突出的作用——至少直到第二次世界大战为止（参见 Chapman 1988, Cronin 1988, Cumings 1988, Dower 1988, Eden 1988, Geyer 1988, Gran 1988a, Levine 1988, Rice 1988, Stein 1988）。

Note the meaning of these changes. On the average state formation moved from a relatively "internal" to a strongly "external" process. War has weighed heavily on the formation of states throughout the history we have been surveying; to that extent the process has always been external. Nonetheless the further we go back in time the more we see rulers and would-be rulers struggle to tame the populations within the territories they nominally control, fight off armed rivals within those territories, conquer adjacent lands and peoples, and build up their own monopolies of force. Thus we see them inadvertently constructing states whose structures bear the marks of the struggles and bargains that brought them into being. Conversely, as we move forward in time we witness the increasing salience of concerts among states for the fate of any particular state - at least until World War II (see Chapman 1988, Cronin 1988, Cumings 1988, Dower 1988, Eden 1988, Geyer 1988, Gran 1988a, Levine 1988, Rice 1988, Stein 1988).

比利时作为一个单独国家的出现，说明了外部影响在欧洲的重要性（Clark 1984, Zolberg 1978）。1831年以前，比利时从未真正是一个分立而统一的国家；它大致形成于低地国家中西班牙（后来是奥地利哈布斯堡）在尼德兰起义之后所保留的那一部分。法国在1795年征服并兼并了这些领土，并一直占有到1815年的战争和解；二十年的法国行政统治改变了该地区的经济，使之成为欧洲主要的工业中心之一。拿破仑之后的解决方案把该地区划归一个新成立、设在海牙的尼德兰王国。不久，一个由工业家、自由派、讲法语者和天主教徒组成的联盟（这些类别相互重叠，但绝非同一）就在施压要求地区权利。

Belgium's appearance as a separate state illustrates the significance of external influences in Europe (Clark 1984, Zolberg 1978). Never really a distinct and unified state before 1831, Belgium formed in approximately the section of the Low Countries that Spain, and then the Austrian Habsburgs, retained after the revolt of the Netherlands. France conquered and incorporated those territories in 1795, and held them until the war settlement of 1815; twenty years of French administration transformed the region's economy, and made it one of Europe's prime industrial centers. The post-Napoleonic settlement assigned the region to a newly-formed kingdom of the Netherlands seated at the Hague. Soon a coalition of industrialists, liberals, francophones, and Catholics (the categories overlapped, but were by no means identical) were pressing for regional rights.

1830年10月，该联盟的积极分子受邻国法国七月革命的鼓舞，组成了一个革命的临时政府，而法国报复的威胁使荷兰政府不敢以武力回应。11月，英国召集了一次欧洲列强会议，该会议在次月宣布尼德兰王国解体为其两个组成部分。在法国和英国的密切监视下，新近得名的比利时人随即着手招募国王并起草一部自由主义宪法。当伦敦会议提出一项对荷兰相对不利的长期解决方案时，荷兰国王威廉派兵入境，击败了临时组建的比利时军队，并招致法国入侵；英国后来也加入把荷兰军队逐出如今将成为比利时领土的努力。1839年，威廉国王终于接受了一项解决方案，它不仅承认比利时，还使一个独立（尽管领土缩小）的卢森堡公国作为分立国家诞生。从头到尾，比利时进入欧洲国家体系都经过一条由其强大邻国挖成的渠道。

In October 1830 the activists of that coalition, inspired by the July Revolution in neighboring France, formed a revolutionary provisional government, and the threat of French retaliation stayed the Dutch government from reacting with force. In November, the British convened a conference of European powers, which the following month declared the dissolution of the kingdom of the Netherlands into its two component parts. Under the close surveillance of France and Britain the newly baptized Belgians then went about recruiting a king and drafting a liberal constitution. When the London conference proposed a long-term settlement that was relatively unfavorable to Holland, Holland's King William sent in an army, defeated improvised Belgian troops, and incited a French invasion; the British later joined in the effort to expel Dutch forces from what was now to be Belgian territory. In 1839, King William finally accepted a settlement that not only recognized Belgium but also launched an independent (if territorially diminished) duchy of Luxembourg as a distinct state. From beginning to end, the entrance of Belgium into the European state system passed through a channel dug by its powerful neighbours.

在过去三个世纪中，强国之间的协定日益压缩了任何国家内部权力争夺的空间。它们通过以下方式做到这一点：强加国际战争解决方案，组织殖民地，传播军队、官僚机构和国家机器其他要素的标准模型，创建负责照管国家体系的国际组织，集体保证国家边界，以及为维持国内秩序而进行干预。这种收窄限制了国家形成的替代路径。在世界各地，国家形成都汇聚于或多或少有意识地建设民族国家——不是帝国，不是城邦，不是联邦，而是民族国家——依照大国所提供、资助和强制的模型。

Over the last three centuries, compacts of powerful states have increasingly narrowed the limits within which any national struggle for power occurred. They have done so through imposition of international war settlements, organization of colonies, diffusion of standard models for armies, bureaucracies, and other elements of the state apparatus, creation of international organizations charged with tending the state system, collective guarantee of national borders, and intervention to maintain domestic order. That narrowing restricted the alternative paths of state formation. Throughout the world state formation converged on the more or less deliberate construction of national states - not empires, not city-states, not federations, but national states - according to models offered, subsidized, and enforced by the great powers.

这并不是说想要成为统治者的人或其庇护者可以像订购预制房屋那样直接订制一整个国家。当一个欧洲强国在其某个殖民地设立法院、财政制度、警察、军队或学校时，它通常遵循欧洲的准则。当独立的第三世界国家向大国求助以组织市场、制造业或军事力量时，大国通常说服它们按欧洲方式组织。当世界银行这样的国际机构向挣扎中的非欧洲国家贷款时，它们照例规定这些国家要进行“改革”，使之与欧洲和美国的做法一致。最后，当穷国四处寻找教育其官僚、技术人员和军官的地方时，它们常常把人送到欧洲或其某个延伸地区受训。一旦民族国家支配了欧洲以及主要由欧洲人定居的世界部分地区，它就充当了各地国家形成的模板。

Not that would-be rulers or their patrons simply ordered up a whole state like a prefabricated house. When a European power installed courts, fiscal systems, police, armies, or schools in one of its colonies it usually followed European precepts. When independent Third World states turned to great powers for help in organizing markets, manufacturing, or military might the great powers commonly persuaded them to organize the European way. When such international institutions as the World Bank loaned money to struggling non-European states they regularly stipulated that those states undertake "reforms" bringing them into line with European and American practices. When, finally, poor countries looked around for places to educate their bureaucrats, technicians, and military officers they often sent them to train in Europe or one of its extensions. Once the national state dominated Europe and parts of the world settled chiefly by Europeans, it served as the template for state formation everywhere.

为什么是民族国家？民族国家之所以在全世界胜出，是因为它们先在欧洲胜出，而欧洲的国家随后又采取行动复制自身。它们之所以在欧洲胜出，是因为最强大的国家——首先是法国和西班牙——采取了暂时压碎其邻国的战争形式，而对这种战争的支撑又作为副产品造就了国家机器的集权、分化和自主性。那些国家在15世纪后期迈出这一步，既因为它们刚刚完成了把敌对势力逐出其领土，也因为它们能够接近资本家，后者可以帮助它们为依靠昂贵防御工事、火炮以及最重要的雇佣兵进行的战争提供资金。

Why national states? National states won out in the world as a whole because they first won out in Europe, whose states then acted to reproduce themselves. They won out in Europe because the most powerful states - France and Spain before all others - adopted forms of warfare that temporarily crushed their neighbors, and whose support generated as by-products centralization, differentiation, and autonomy of the state apparatus. Those states took that step in the late fifteenth century both because they had recently completed the expulsion of rival powers from their territories and because they had access to capitalists who could help them finance wars fought by means of expensive fortifications, artillery and, above all, mercenary soldiers.

让我不要夸大：荷兰共和国和威尼斯这样的海上国家又有一个世纪有效地与主要陆地强国竞争；对海岸的控制对于供应内陆仍然至关重要，它们的舰队帮助保护它们免遭入侵，海外帝国也日益重要。一些相对非商业化的国家，如瑞典和勃兰登堡，通过对领土进行巨大的强制性渗透，设法建立了有竞争力的军事力量。但最终，只有那些把重要资本来源与能产出庞大国内军事力量的大量人口结合起来的国家，才在新的欧洲战争方式中表现出色。这些国家就是或变成了民族国家。

Let me not exaggerate: maritime states such as the Dutch Republic and Venice competed effectively with major land powers for another century; control of coasts remained crucial for supplying the interior, their fleets helped protect them from invasion, and overseas empires were growing in importance. Some relatively uncommercialized states, such as Sweden and Brandenburg, managed to build competitive military forces through an enormous coercive penetration of their territories. But eventually only those countries that combined significant sources of capital with substantial populations yielding large domestic military forces did well in the new European style of warfare. Those countries were, or became, national states.

即使法国和西班牙在15世纪末不那么好斗，民族国家无疑仍会在欧洲胜出。在16和17世纪，许多其他欧洲国家曾一度试图在欧洲内部进行征服：瑞典、勃兰登堡和俄国立刻浮现在脑海中。此外，荷兰共和国、葡萄牙和大不列颠开始争夺海外帝国，对国家与公民之间的关系产生了许多相同的效果。欧洲国家在1500年对地球约7%的陆地拥有政治控制，1800年为35%，1914年为84%（Headrick 1981: 3）。这种扩张本身就促进了民族国家在全世界的增殖。如果是另一种国家组合主导了这些斗争，它们的特性会显著影响欧洲国家形成的路径与结果。尽管如此，资本的扩张和16世纪战争的重组仍共同有利于民族国家日益增长的主导地位。

National states would no doubt have prevailed in Europe even if France and Spain had been less aggressive at the end of the fifteenth century. During the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries many other European states attempted conquest within Europe for a time: Sweden, Brandenburg, and Russia come immediately to mind. In addition, the Dutch Republic, Portugal and Great Britain began competing for overseas empires, with many of the same effects on relations between states and citizens. European states held political control over about 7 percent of the earth's land in 1500, 35 percent in 1800, and 84 percent in 1914 (Headrick 1981: 3). That expansion in itself facilitated the multiplication of national states throughout the world. If another combination of states had dominated the struggles, their character would have affected the path and outcomes of European state formation significantly. Still, the expansion of capital and the reorganization of war in the sixteenth century jointly favored the increasing dominance of national states.

一个由战争锻造的体系，塑造了其成员走向战争的条件。在我们所考察的漫长时期中，国家走向战争的条件发生了重大变化——而且不止一次。这些条件会因一个国家的首要对手、其统治阶级的性质，以及为其统治阶级所从事的保护活动的种类而发生显著的调节；同时，它们又随一个如今已为人熟知的恒定逻辑而变化，这个逻辑在不断变化的环境中继续起作用：统治者通常试图既建立一个可以从强制中获取收益的安全区域，又建立一个设防的缓冲区来保护这个安全区域。当这种努力奏效时，缓冲区变成了安全区，这又鼓励强制手段的持有者去获取一个环绕旧区的新缓冲区。只要邻近的强国遵循同样的逻辑，战争就会发生。在欧洲，罗马帝国一旦崩溃，成千上万的军阀就投入同样的操练。于是就有了持续不断、广泛存在——尽管主要是地区性的——战争。后来国家领土的扩大、以紧凑的民族国家取代多重领土、以及通过国际协议保障边界，大大缩短了易受攻击边界的长度，但并未消除助长战争的逻辑。

A system wrought by war shaped the conditions under which its members went to war. The conditions under which states went to war changed significantly - and more than once - during the long period we are examining. With significant modulations as a function of a state's chief rivals, the character of its dominant classes, and the sort of protective activity undertaken on its dominant classes' behalf, conditions changed as a function of a now-familiar constant logic that continued to operate under shifting circumstances: rulers normally tried to establish both a secure area within which they could enjoy the returns from coercion and a fortified buffer zone to protect the secure area. When the effort worked well, the buffer zone became a secure area, which encouraged the wielder of coercion to acquire a new buffer zone surrounding the old. So long as adjacent powers were pursuing the same logic, war resulted. In Europe, once the Roman Empire collapsed, thousands of warlords engaged in the same exercise. Hence unceasing and widespread, if chiefly regional, warfare. The later enlargement of state territories, the substitution of compact national states for multiple territories and the securing of borders through international agreements greatly reduced the length of vulnerable borders, but did not eliminate the war-promoting logic.

然而，其他条件发生了剧烈的变化。在家产制时代（欧洲大部分地区直到1400年），控制大量强制手段的群体通常是亲属群体、邻人、由战士组成的誓盟共同体，或这三者的结合。公爵世系是第一种的例证，十字军骑士团是第二种的例证，封建贵族则是它们的结合。控制大量强制手段的群体一般力求使他们能从周围人口中抽取的贡赋最大化（必要时使用武力），并确保贡赋在未来对其后代和追随者仍然可得。通过通婚、创造一个贵族等级，以及（在天主教会的鼓励下，因为教会从土地和收入的捐赠中获益）建立广泛共享的继承规则，统治阶级为王朝政治奠定了基础：在这种政治中，婚姻巩固国家之间的联盟，继承则成为国际关注的对象。与此同时，农民共同体、城市民兵、盗匪团伙以及其他对国家权威毫无主张的群体常常自行作战。结果，战争往往在以下情况下发生：一个权力持有者在其邻人面前显出软弱的迹象，出现有争议的继承，以及一个新的征服者登场。
Other conditions, however, altered drastically. During the era of
patrimonialism

(up to 1400 in much of Europe), the groups that controlled substantial coercive means were typically either kin groups, neighbors, sworn communities of warriors, or combinations of the three. Ducal lineages exemplify the first, crusading orders the second, and feudal aristocracies their combination. Groups that controlled substantial coercive means generally sought to maximize the tribute they could extract from surrounding populations, by force if necessary, and to assure the future availability of tribute for their offspring and followers. By intermarrying, creating a noble caste, and (encouraged by a Catholic church that benefited from donations of land and revenues) establishing widely shared rules of inheritance, the ruling classes laid the groundwork for dynastic politics in which marriages cemented alliances among states and successions became the object of international attention. At the same time peasant communities, urban militias, groups of brigands, and other groups having no claims to state authority often warred on their own. As a result, wars tended to occur when a powerholder showed signs of weakness vis-a-vis his neighbor, when a disputable succession occurred, and when a new conqueror heaved onto the scene.

的确，在我们这个千年的前半段，几乎不值得问国家在何时作战，因为大多数国家在大部分时间里都在作战。诚然，集结的军队主要依靠民兵和封建征召，这意味着每年的军事行动通常只持续几个月。然而，一场国际战争一旦开始，通常会经历多轮战役。约1150年至1300年间，英格兰和法国近乎一年一度的战争节奏被打断，但即便在那时，斯堪的纳维亚、俄国、意大利、地中海和伊比利亚也都目睹了连绵不断的战争。此外，在一个主权极度碎裂的时期，士兵、匪徒、海盗、叛乱者和尽职的领主之间的差别模糊成一条强制行动的连续谱。在大规模战役之间，地方性战斗层出不穷。在1500年以前，更有意义的问题不是国家何时作战，而是谁与谁作战、多久一次、多么激烈。
For the first half of our millennium, indeed, it is hardly worth asking
when

states warred, since most states were warring most of the time. True, massed armies drew chiefly on militias and feudal levies, which means that campaigns ordinarily went on during only a few months of each year. When an international war began, nevertheless, it usually ran for many campaigns. The decades from about 1150 to 1300 broke the nearly annual rhythm of war in England and France, but even then Scandinavia, Russia, Italy, the Mediterranean, and Iberia all saw incessant warfare. In a period of intensely fragmented sovereignty, furthermore, the differences among soldiers, bandits, pirates, rebels, and lords doing their duty blurred into a continuum of coercive action. Between great campaigns, local battles multiplied. Before 1500, the more meaningful questions are not when states warred, but who fought whom, how often, and how vigorously.
从16世纪起，情况发生了根本的变化。国家体系的巩固、军事生活与平民生活的分离，以及平民人口的解除武装，使战争与和平之间的区分变得鲜明。战争变得更激烈、更具破坏性，一旦开始就更连续，但成为远为罕见的事件。在这方面，20世纪只是为一个长期趋势封了顶。

From the sixteenth century onward, the situation changed fundamentally. Consolidation of the state system, segregation of military from civilian life, and disarmament of the civilian population sharpened the distinction between war and peace. War became more intense and destructive, more continuous once it began, but a much rarer event. The twentieth century, in that respect, merely caps a long-term trend.
在经纪时代（在欧洲大陆的重要地区大致为1400年至1700年），王朝野心仍然支配着国家政策，但国家机器的体量和战争投入的规模意味着，支持国家的主要阶级的利益严重限制了战争的可能性；只有得到它们的同意与合作，君主才能汇集作战的手段。在强制密集型国家中，地主的利益举足轻重；在资本密集型国家中，资本家的利益举足轻重。
In the time of
brokerage

(roughly 1400 to 1700 in important parts of the continent), dynastic ambitions still dominated state policy, but the bulk of the state apparatus and the scale of war efforts meant that the interests of the major classes supporting the state seriously limited the possibilities for war; only with their consent and collaboration could monarchs assemble the means to fight. The interests of landlords weighed heavily in coercion-intensive states, the interests of capitalists in capital-intensive states.

在经纪体制下，战争仍随王朝机会、邻国的软弱以及鞑靼人或土耳其人等征服者的到来而发生，但若干事情发生了变化。统治阶级的商业机会与威胁更频繁地成为战争的时机；经济基础正在扩张的国家变得更能抓住机会、阻挡威胁；国家之间的联盟进入了那些机会与威胁的定义之中；这类联盟常常为了遏制当前最强大国家的扩张而形成；扩张中的国家更经常为扩大其连片领土而战，而不是不顾位置去积聚新的纳贡单位；由统治者试图抽取战争手段或强加一种国教所激起的大规模叛乱，为邻国的干预提供了更频繁的机会。与此同时，平民人口的逐渐解除武装减少了非政府群体作为战斗者——唉，但不是作为受害者——在战争中的卷入。在某种程度上，对同教信徒的保卫取代王朝继承，成为一个国家干预另一国家事务的理由。

Under the regime of brokerage, wars still followed dynastic opportunity, the weakness of adjacent states, and the arrival of conquerors such as the Tatars or the Turks, but several things changed. The dominant classes' commercial opportunities and threats became more frequently occasions for war, states whose economic bases were expanding became much more able to seize opportunities and head off threats, alliances among states entered the definitions of those opportunities and threats, such alliances frequently formed to contain the expansion of the currently most powerful state, expanding states fought more often to enlarge their contiguous territories rather than to accrete new tribute-paying units regardless of their location, and large-scale rebellions incited by rulers' attempts to extract the means of war or to impose a national religion provided more frequent opportunities for intervention by neighboring states. Meanwhile the gradual disarmament of the civilian population reduced the involvement of non-governmental groups as combatants - but not, alas, as victims - in wars. To some extent, the defense of coreligionists displaced dynastic inheritance as the ground of intervention by one state in the affairs of another.
随着欧洲国家进入国家化阶段（特别是在1700年至1850年间，各类国家之间差异很大），王朝在很大程度上失去了为自身利益发动战争的能力，而我们含糊地称为“国家利益”的东西开始支配各国对战争的卷入或不卷入。国家利益综合了统治阶级的利益，但又把一种远为强烈的、控制在欧洲内部连片领土与人口的驱动力，以及对欧洲之外土地的更激烈竞争，叠加在它们之上。
As European states moved into the phase of
nationalization

(especially between 1700 and 1850, with wide variation from one kind of state to another), dynasties lost much of their ability to make war on their own behalf, and something we vaguely call "national interest" came to dominate states' involvement or non-involvement in wars. National interest synthesized the interests of the dominant classes, but compounded them with a much stronger drive to control contiguous territories and populations within Europe, as well as a fiercer competition for land outside of Europe.

在国家化之下，三项关键变化影响了战争的条件：整个国家体系的当前状况——尤其是当前在多大程度上存在均势——开始对战争的可能性和地点产生重大影响（Levy 1988）；越来越常见的是，实力趋于相等的国家成对开战，尤其是当它们占据相邻领土时（Organski and Kugler 1980, Moul 1988, Houweling and Siccama 1988）；国民收入总额（而非人均）开始前所未有地限制国家的军事能力，结果是大型商业和工业国家开始在国家体系中占据优势。以对收益的理性预期和对损失的理性最小化为基础的战争时代降临到欧洲及其延伸地区。与此同时，第三方更频繁地干预针对复合君主制的民族主义叛乱，例如法国、英国和俄国在1827年加入希腊人反抗奥斯曼帝国的起义。作为干预的理由，共同民族性取代了王朝继承和共同宗教。

Under nationalization, three critical changes affected the conditions for war: the current condition of the entire state system - notably the extent to which a balance of power currently obtained - began to make a major difference in the likelihood and location of war (Levy 1988); increasingly, pairs of states that were approaching equality of power went to war, especially if they occupied adjacent territories (Organski and Kugler 1980, Moul 1988, Houweling and Siccama 1988); total (rather than per capita) national income began limiting the military capacity of states as never before, with the result that large commercial and industrial states began to prevail within the state system. The era of war on the basis of rational expectations of gain and rational minimization of loss came upon Europe and its extensions. At the same time, third parties intervened much more frequently in nationalist rebellions against composite monarchies, as when France, Britain, and Russia joined the Greeks in their 1827 revolt against the Ottoman Empire. As grounds for intervention, common nationality displaced both dynastic inheritance and shared religion.
在随后的专业化时期，战争的条件变化相对较小，只是远离本国领土的对帝国的竞争——无论是直接的还是间接的——比以往任何时候都发挥了更大的作用。1945年以后，苏联与美国之间的僵持几乎消除了欧洲国家在欧洲内部的战争，却使苏联、美国和中国力量在欧洲之外的接触点成为追求国家利益的关键地点。
During the subsequent period of
specialization,

the conditions for war altered relatively little, except that competition for empire - direct or indirect - far from the national territory played a larger part than ever. After 1945, the standoff between the Soviet Union and the United States almost eliminated war among European states within Europe, but made the points of contact among Soviet, American, and Chinese power outside of Europe critical locations for the pursuit of national interest.

随着武装力量的国家化和专业化，国际战争与革命、叛乱和内战发展出一种相互关系。在王朝通常控制国家的那些世纪里，统治亲属群体中的削弱——例如国王去世而继承人尚在襁褓，或干脆没有继承人——向国家之外的对手示意进攻的机会。当叛乱先发生时，它招引外来者为支持挑战者而进行干预。随着宗教分歧成为根本性的国家事务（这意味着特别是在1520年至1650年间），干预的诱因变得更为有力。统治者从不情愿的人口中抽取大大增加的战争手段的努力，以及国家因战争损失而削弱，有时都会激起叛乱和内战。如果叛乱联盟在与统治者的战斗中获胜、取代了他们并进行了社会变革，全面的革命就随之而来。

With the nationalization and specialization of armed force, international war developed a reciprocal relationship to revolution, rebellion, and civil war. During the centuries in which dynasties usually controlled states, a weakening in the ruling kin group - for example, the death of a king with an infant heir or none at all - signaled to rivals outside the state an opportunity to attack. When rebellion occurred first, it invited outsiders to intervene on behalf of the challengers. As religious divisions became fundamental matters of state (which means especially between 1520 and 1650), the incentives to intervene became even more compelling. Both the effort of a ruler to extract greatly increased means of war from a reluctant population and the weakening of a state through losses in war sometimes incited rebellions and civil wars. If the rebel coalition won its battle with the rulers, displaced them, and undertook a social transformation, a full-scale revolution resulted.
欧洲所有的伟大革命，以及许多较小的革命，都始于战争所施加的重压。英国革命始于查理一世绕过议会、为在欧洲大陆以及苏格兰和爱尔兰的战争获取收入的努力。法国君主制在七年战争和美国独立战争期间积累的债务促发了法国革命的斗争。俄国在第一次世界大战中的损失使沙皇统治失去信誉，鼓励了军队的叛离，并使国家的脆弱性变得显而易见；1917年的各次革命随之而来。

All of Europe's great revolutions, and many of its lesser ones, began with the strains imposed by war. The English Revolution began with the efforts of Charles I to bypass Parliament in acquiring revenues for war on the continent and in Scotland and Ireland. The debt accumulated by the French monarchy during the Seven Years' War and the War of American Independence precipitated the struggles of the French Revolution. Russian losses in World War I discredited tsarist rule, encouraged military defections, and made the state's vulnerability patent; the revolutions of 1917 followed.

国家形成也影响了未达革命程度的大众集体行动的节奏与性质。在经纪和国家化阶段，对金钱和人力的需求虽然间歇，却大规模增长，一再在村庄或地区层面激起抵抗。当地人赶走收税人，袭击包税人的住宅，把他们的年轻男子藏起来不让征兵者找到，向国王请愿请求宽免，请求庇护人代为说项，并抵抗清点他们财富的努力。他们尤其把矛头指向与国家相连的当地人，无论是作为国家官员还是作为间接统治的代理人。随着国家化的后期阶段和向专业化的转变，大众集体行动本身也转向全国范围，并变得更加自主；当民族国家的政策与要求越来越直接地作用于他们的命运时，工人、农民和其他普通人联合起来向国家提出主张——当然是要求纠正不公的主张，但也是为他们此前从未在全国范围内享有的权利而提出的主张（Tilly, Tilly, and Tilly 1975, Tilly 1986）。政党、特殊利益协会、全国性社会运动以及大众政治的所有其他形式都成形了。因此，战争不仅驱动了国家体系和单个国家的形成，也推动了掌控国家的权力的分配。即使西方政府在最近几个世纪中经历了文官化，战争仍然是民族国家的界定性活动。

State formation also affected the rhythms and character of popular collective action short of revolution. During the phases of brokerage and nationalization, episodic but massively increasing demands for money and men repeatedly stimulated resistance at the level of the village or the region. Local people ran out the tax collector, attacked the house of the tax farmer, hid their young men from recruiters, petitioned the king for relief, asked patrons to intercede for them, and fought efforts to inventory their wealth. They aimed especially at local people who were linked to the state, either as state officials or as agents of indirect rule. With the later stages of nationalization and the movement to specialization, popular collective action itself nationalized and became more autonomous; as the national state's policies and demands came to bear more and more directly on their fates, workers, peasants, and other ordinary people banded together to make claims on the state - claims for redress, certainly, but also claims for rights they had never previously enjoyed at a national scale (Tilly, Tilly, and Tilly 1975, Tilly 1986). The political party, the special-interest association, the national social movement, and all the rest of popular politics took shape. Thus war drove not only the state system and the formation of individual states, but also the distribution of power over the state. Even with the last few centuries' civilianization of Western governments, war has remained the defining activity of national states.
为了衡量我们已走了多远，让我们回到开启这项探究的那些问题。这一次，让我们颠倒顺序，先处理较为具体的问题，再引向一般性的问题。

As a way of gauging how far we have come, let us return to the questions that began this inquiry. This time, let us reverse the order, taking the more detailed questions, and leading up to the general problem.
**整个欧洲国家形成大致呈同心圆的格局，原因何在？**我们现在看到，这个问题在某些方面误述了最初的情况。公元990年，几乎整个欧洲都生活在碎裂的主权之中。然而碎裂的性质和程度各不相同。在外圈的不同区段，大土地所有者和游牧劫掠者相对自主地部署强制手段，尽管在大多数情况下，他们中的某一位带有公爵、汗或国王之类的头衔，从其他人那里获得敬意和贡赋，并对其他人的间歇性兵役享有权利要求。
What accounts for the roughly concentric pattern of state formation in Europe as a whole?

We now see that the question misstates the initial situation in some regards. In AD 990, almost all of Europe lived in fragmented sovereignty. Yet the character and degree of fragmentation varied. In different segments of the outer circle, large landlords and nomadic raiders deployed coercion in relative autonomy, although in most cases one of them bore some such title as duke, khan, or king, received deference and tribute from the others, and had claims on the intermittent military service of the rest.
欧洲各国在国家形成路径上的巨大地理差异，反映了强制与资本的分布差异。在以俄国和匈牙利为典型的外圈，集中资本的稀少、由此而来的城市与资本家的软弱、武装地主的强大，以及与蒙古人这样强大入侵者的斗争，使那些能够在不筹集大量现金的情况下从地主和农民身上榨取军事力量的统治者占了优势。走强制密集型路径的国家吸收地主和教士，使农民处于从属地位，建立庞大的官僚机构，并压制它们的资产阶级。

Europe's gross geographic variation in paths of state formation reflected the differential distribution of coercion and capital. In the outer circle, typified by Russia and Hungary, the rarity of concentrated capital, the consequent weakness of cities and capitalists, the strength of armed landlords, and the struggle with powerful invaders such as the Mongols gave the advantage to rulers who could squeeze military force from landlords and peasants without raising large amounts of cash. States following the coercion-intensive path co-opted landlords and clergy, subordinated the peasantry, built extensive bureaucracies, and stifled their bourgeoisies.
在内圈，以威尼斯和尼德兰为典型，资本的集中和资本家的优势同时促进了军事力量的创造，并抑制了强制专家对国家的夺取。数百年间，该地带的海上国家享有巨大的经济和政治权力。然而，最终它们发现自身被那些从自己人口中抽调庞大军队的大型陆基国家所围困或征服。

In the inner zone, typified by Venice and the Netherlands, the concentration of capital and predominance of capitalists simultaneously facilitated the creation of military force and inhibited the seizure of states by specialists in coercion. For centuries the maritime states of the zone enjoyed great economic and political power. Finally, however, they found themselves hedged in or conquered by large land-based states that drew large armies from their own populations.
介于两者之间的是那些把大量国内资本来源与有助于建立庞大武装力量的地主—耕作者关系结合起来的国家——特别是法国、英国和后来的普鲁士。它们从自身资源中维持军队的优越能力，最终使它们支配了其他类型的国家。而且，建设军队的活动很早就把它们变成了民族国家。

In between lay those states - notably France, Britain, and the later Prussia - that combined substantial sources of domestic capital with landlord-cultivator relations facilitating the creation of massive armed force. Their superior ability to sustain armies from their own resources eventually made them dominant over other sorts of states. The activity of building armies, furthermore, turned them early into national states.

伊比利亚半岛提供了三种经验的一个有趣的复合体：由巴塞罗那支配的加泰罗尼亚，只要地中海贸易繁荣，它的行为就很像城邦；卡斯蒂利亚把军事力量建立在武士贵族和被征服的农民之上，但依靠外国财富来雇用雇佣兵；葡萄牙则在里斯本和它极为乡村化的腹地之间截然分裂；巴伦西亚、安达卢西亚、纳瓦拉等地还有别的组合。不过，所有国家都比我这一简单类型学所要求的更为复合：英国有英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰、爱尔兰和海外属地；普鲁士最终从乡村的波美拉尼亚延伸到城市化的莱茵兰；奥斯曼帝国有时经由贸易性的地中海岛屿从波斯伸展到匈牙利；各个哈布斯堡帝国及其继承者散布在欧洲大多数的气候带和经济之中。强制密集型、资本密集型和资本化强制这三条国家形成路径之间的区分，抓住了地理与时间变异的重要部分，但不是全部。

The Iberian peninsula provides an interesting composite of all three experiences: a Catalonia, dominated by Barcelona, that acted much like a city-state so long as Mediterranean trade flourished, a Castile building military might on a warrior nobility and a subjugated peasantry but drawing on foreign riches to hire mercenaries, a Portugal sharply divided between Lisbon and its profoundly rural hinterland, other combinations yet in Valencia, Andalusia, Navarre, and elsewhere. But then all states were more composite than my simple typology demands: Britain with its England, Wales, Scotland, Ireland, and overseas possessions; Prussia with its eventual stretch from rural Pomerania to citified Rhineland, the Ottoman Empire with its span sometimes reaching from Persia to Hungary via the trading Mediterranean islands, the various Habsburg empires and their successors, scattered over most of Europe's climes and economies. The distinction between coercion-intensive, capital-intensive, and capitalized-coercion paths of state formation captures a significant part of the geographic and temporal variation, but not all of it.

**尽管有显而易见的相反利益，为什么统治者仍常常接受建立代表其管辖之下人口中主要阶级的机构？**君主们是在极为不同的条件下玩同一场游戏——战争和争夺领土的游戏。战争变得越昂贵、所需资源越多，他们就越不得不为战争所需的手段进行讨价还价。讨价还价产生或强化了以等级会议、议会（Cortes）以及最终的国家立法机构为形式的代议机构。讨价还价从给予特权的吸收一直延伸到大规模的武装镇压，但它留下了主权者与臣民之间的契约。尽管法国和普鲁士等国的统治者数百年间设法绕开了大多数旧的代议机构，但随着经常性征税、信贷和国债偿付对持续生产武装力量变得必不可少，那些代议机构或其继承者最终相对于王权获得了更多权力。

Why, despite obvious interests to the contrary, did rulers frequently accept the establishment of institutions representing the major classes within the populations that fell subject to the state's jurisdiction?

Monarchs were playing the same game - the game of war and competition for territory - under vastly different conditions. The more expensive and demanding war became, the more they had to bargain for its wherewithal. The bargaining produced or fortified representative institutions in the form of Estates, Cortes, and eventually national legislatures. Bargaining ranged from co-optation with privilege to massive armed repression, but it left behind compacts between sovereign and subjects. Although rulers of states such as France and Prussia managed to circumvent most of the old representative institutions for several centuries, those representative institutions or their successors eventually acquired more power vis-a-vis the crown as regular taxation, credit, and payment for the national debt became essential to the continued production of armed force.

**为什么欧洲各国在把城市寡头集团和城市机构纳入民族国家结构方面差异如此之大？**总体而言，在集中资本占优势的地方——以及在集中资本占优势的程度上——城市机构成为民族国家结构的持久要素。这出于两个原因：第一，强大的资本家集群长期拥有动机和手段，去阻止不是资本家的地主在其附近积聚强制权力的任何尝试；第二，随着战争的规模与费用扩大，能够获得信贷以及一个商业化、易于征税的经济的统治者在战争中获得了巨大优势，这一事实赋予主要贸易城市及其商业寡头集团相当大的讨价还价能力。
Why did European states vary so much with respect to the incorporation of urban oligarchies and institutions into national state structure?

On the whole, urban institutions became durable elements of national state structure where - and to the degree that - concentrated capital prevailed. That happened for two reasons: first because strong clusters of capitalists long had the incentive and the means to block any attempt by non-capitalist landlords at accumulating coercive power in their vicinities; second, because as the scale and expense of war expanded rulers who had access to credit and a commercialized, easily taxable, economy gained great advantages in the conduct of war, a fact which gave considerable bargaining power to major trading cities and their commercial oligarchies.

在一个极端，波兰资本的软弱有利于地主对国家的主宰，以致国王从未获得对其名义臣民的有效优先地位。除格但斯克这一部分例外，波兰贵族把他们的城市榨干了。在另一个极端，荷兰共和国资本的强大实际上把中央政府缩减为城邦的联邦。然而，那些联合城邦的巨大商业力量给了它们迅速组建海军和雇用军队的手段。在国家—资本地区，统治者使城市从属于国家，并把它们用作统治的工具，但也把城市的资本和资本家用于生产武装力量；国家一般并不把城市机构和寡头集团本身纳入国家结构，而是谈出给予它们相当大权力的代表形式。

At one extreme, the weakness of capital in Poland facilitated mastery of landlords over the state, to such a degree that kings never acquired effective priority over their nominal subjects. With the partial exception of Gdansk, Polish nobles squeezed their cities dry. At the other extreme, the strength of capital in the Dutch Republic practically reduced the national government to a federation of city-states. Nevertheless, the immense commercial power of those federated city-states gave them the means of forming navies and hiring armies with great rapidity. In state-capital regions, rulers subordinated cities to the state and used them as instruments of rule, but also employed their capital and capitalists in the production of armed force; states did not generally incorporate urban institutions and oligarchies into the national structure as such, but bargained out forms of representation that gave them considerable power.

**为什么政治和商业权力从地中海的城邦和城市帝国转移到大西洋沿岸实力雄厚的国家及相对从属的城市？**我们对990年至1990年这一千年的回顾，使这一重要转移进入了视野，并对单一霸权的整齐更替——比如说从威尼斯到葡萄牙再到英国——提出了疑问。也许我们可以把棕榈枝授予19世纪某段时期的大不列颠（并由此帮助解释1815年至1914年间欧洲主要战争的相对缺席）。但在那之前，至少总有两个强大的国家在欧洲争夺主导地位；它们中没有哪个曾做到。在商业方面，15世纪后期变得明显的扩张冲击了广泛的欧洲城市地区；它支持了一场文艺复兴，其中心仍然是意大利北部的城邦，但其分支延伸到德意志、佛兰德和法国，也支持了一场宗教改革，其最初的焦点是德意志南部和中部的城市。此外，威尼斯、热那亚、拉古萨和其他地中海城邦继续繁荣——即使未能占据优势——直到18世纪。
Why did political and commercial power slide from the city-states and city-empires of the Mediterranean to the substantial states and relatively subordinated cities of the Atlantic?

Our review of the millennium from 990 to 1990 puts that important shift into perspective, and raises doubts about the neat succession of single hegemony from, say, Venice to Portugal to Britain. Perhaps we can award the palm to Great Britain for part of the nineteenth century (and thus help explain the relative absence of major European wars between 1815 and 1914). But before then at least two powerful states were always contending for dominance in Europe; none of them ever made it. On the commercial side, the expansion that became evident in the later fifteenth century impinged on a wide range of European urban areas; it supported a Renaissance whose center remained the city-states of northern Italy, but whose ramifications reached Germany, Flanders, and France, as well as a Reformation whose initial focus was the cities of southern and central Germany. Venice, Genoa, Ragusa, and other Mediterranean city-states, furthermore, continued to prosper, if not to prevail, into the eighteenth century.

然而，商业和政治的重心在15世纪之后确实向西北移动了。首先，欧洲与东方城市之间经由陆路和沿岸的商业往来，由于游牧入侵、疾病以及最终欧洲开辟绕非洲通往亚洲的远洋航线而萎缩。随后，相互强化的大西洋贸易和波罗的海贸易使卡斯蒂利亚、葡萄牙、法国、英格兰和尼德兰比欧洲其余部分更富。所有这些国家都利用它们的新财富来建设军事力量，并用军事力量去寻找新财富。组建庞大陆军、建造大型船只、进行远洋航行和海外征服的能力，使它们对地中海城邦拥有巨大优势，而那些城邦自己的水路受到穆斯林强国的限制。

Yet the centers of commercial and political gravity certainly moved northwest after the fifteenth century. First the overland and coast-hugging commercial exchanges of Europe with the cities of the East shriveled as a consequence of nomadic invasions, disease, and eventually the European establishment of high-seas itineraries to Asia around Africa. Then the mutually-reinforcing Atlantic and Baltic trades enriched Castile, Portugal, France, England, and the Netherlands more than the rest of Europe. All those states drew on their new wealth to build military power, and used their military to seek out new wealth. The ability to make large armies, big ships, long voyages, and overseas conquests gave them great advantages over Mediterranean city-states whose own waterways were limited by Muslim powers.
**为什么城邦、城市帝国、联邦和宗教组织失去了作为欧洲盛行国家类型的重要性？**在欧洲国家的整个历史中，战争制造和保护导致抽取活动，而抽取活动又必然要与那些掌握战争和保护手段的人讨价还价。这种讨价还价有时导致国家进一步卷入生产、分配和裁决。它总是创造出某种形式的国家结构，其形态随它所处的经济和阶级构型而变化。
Why did city-states, city-empires, federations, and religious organizations lose their importance as prevailing kinds of state in Europe?

Throughout the history of European states, warmaking and protection led to extractive activity, which entailed bargaining with those who held the means of war and protection. That bargaining sometimes led to further involvement of states in production, distribution, and adjudication. It always created some form of state structure, variable according to the economy and configuration of classes within which it occurred.

以各自的方式并在各自的场所，城邦、城市帝国、联邦和宗教组织在欧洲一直繁荣到16世纪；的确，在1557年查理五世退位时，各种类型的帝国仍在欧洲占主导。此后民族国家开始取得优先地位。它们这样做有两个相关的原因：第一，英格兰和法国等较大国家中的商业化和资本积累削弱了小商业国家的战争优势；第二，战争的规模与费用扩大，部分原因是较大国家榨取其经济或殖民地为武装力量付费的能力增强。它们在战争中获胜。较小国家自卫的努力要么使它们转型，要么把它们吸收或合并为民族国家。

In their own ways and places, city-states, city-empires, federations, and religious organizations all thrived in Europe until the sixteenth century; indeed, empires of one kind or another still predominated in Europe at Charles V's abdication in 1557. Then national states began to gain priority. They did so for two related reasons: first, commercialization and capital accumulation in larger states such as England and France reduced the warmaking advantages of the small mercantile states and second, war expanded in scale and cost, partly as a function of the increased ability of the larger states to milk their economies, or their colonies, to pay for armed force. They won at war. The efforts of the smaller states to defend themselves either transformed, absorbed, or combined them into national states.

**为什么战争会从为贡赋而进行的征服和武装征贡者之间的争斗，转变为集结的陆军和海军之间的持久战斗？**请记住从家产制到经纪、到国家化、到专业化的那些转变。是什么驱动了这些转变？成功的征贡者发现自己间接控制着广阔的土地和人口，对这些土地和人口的管理与开发——特别是在与其他主要强国作战之时——创造了持久的国家结构。那些设法把大量资本和资本家纳入其战争准备的人口大国，先通过经纪建立陆军和海军，然后通过国家化把武装力量纳入国家结构，随后是专业化。在每一个阶段，它们都拥有比邻国大得多的规模获取和部署最有效军事技术的手段。由于战争的回报取决于效力而非效率，它们给较小的邻国出了难题：要么以巨大代价进行同样的军事努力，要么接受征服，要么找到一个安全的下属位置。民族国家驱除了其他形式的战争。
Why did war shift from conquest for tribute and struggle among armed tribute-takers to sustained battles among massed armies and navies?

Remember the transitions from patrimonialism to brokerage to nationalization to specialization. What drove those transitions? Successful tribute-takers found themselves in indirect control of extensive lands and populations, whose administration and exploitation - especially in time of war with other major powers - created durable state structure. Those populous states that managed to incorporate substantial capital and capitalists into their preparations for war first built armies and navies through brokerage, and then incorporated the armed forces into state structure through nationalization, followed by specialization. At each stage, they had the means of acquiring and deploying the most effective military technology on a much larger scale than their neighbors. Since war pays off on effectiveness rather than efficiency, they gave smaller neighbors hard choices: mount the same sort of military effort at great cost, accept conquest, or find a safe subordinate niche. National states drove out the other forms of war.

总结一下：**如何解释自公元990年以来欧洲盛行的国家类型在时间与空间上的巨大变异，以及为什么欧洲国家最终汇聚于民族国家的不同变体？为什么变化的方向如此相似，而路径如此不同？**欧洲国家由于集中资本与强制的分布而在极为不同的位置上起步。随着资本与强制交会方式的变化，它们也发生变化。但军事竞争最终把它们全都驱往同一个大致方向。这种竞争奠定了民族国家的创造及其最终优势地位的基础。在此过程中，欧洲人创造了一个支配整个世界的国家体系。我们今天生活在这个国家体系之中。然而，欧洲之外的世界与欧洲的相似只是表面的。在欧洲国家体系向地球其余部分扩展的过程中，某种东西发生了变化——包括军事活动与国家形成之间的关系。关于欧洲经验的知识有助于辨认当代世界一些令人担忧的独特性。下一章（也是最后一章）将对这些独特性表示担忧。
To sum up:
What accounts for the great variation over time and space in the kinds of states that have prevailed in Europe since
and why did European states eventually converge on different variants of the national state? Why were the directions of change so similar and the paths so different?

European states started in very different positions as a function of the distribution of concentrated capital and coercion. They changed as the intersections of capital and coercion altered. But military competition eventually drove them all in the same general direction. It underlay both the creation and the ultimate predominance of the national state. In the process, Europeans created a state system that dominated the entire world. We live within that state system today. Yet the world outside of Europe resembles Europe no more than superficially. Something has changed in the extension of the European state system to the rest of the earth - including the relationship between military activity and state formation. Knowledge of the European experience helps identify some worrisome peculiarities of the contemporary world. The next (and final) chapter worries about those peculiarities.
